headline: MIN @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.54 at ARI 4.58, with a projected total of 9.12. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: MIN moved +0.05 runs while ARI moved +0.40, changing the projected margin by -0.34 runs. The projected total climbed +0.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Taj Bradley has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Bell, Gabriel Moreno, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
